notes: Reuses the existing canonical WorkerCoordinator and merged micro-node GADI resident consumer through a thin worker-protocol bridge plus the mandatory GADI preflight-gated dispatcher.

The bridge receives only the already-created current WorkerCoordinator task row from ProcessWorkerAdapter stdin and projects that exact row into the existing GADI worker-claim source slot after local source resolution.
A zero-blocker READY_FOR_RESIDENT_CONSUMPTION preflight is required before the raw resident consumer may be invoked.
Missing command/InTr/runtime-binding/actuator evidence returns HANDOFF_READY so the current claim is relinquished rather than promoted into execution truth.
Does not create an actuator, runtime, scheduler, heartbeat, credential route, claim/fence plane, InTr admission, or Master Records custody path.
